title: code.implement output
description: The real output is the uncommitted working-tree diff; the user reviews it via the PWA git view. This round writes no step output — it reports via mcp__outpost__submit_step_progress and hands the session back. This schema documents the `implementation` artifact that submit carries.

implementation.description: Markdown summary of the finished implementation: files touched, what each change does, deviations from the plan, and anything left unfinished. Its presence is what tells code.orchestrate-pr the implement rung is done.
